_doc: Signed and counsel-approved strings the license set renders (scripts/test_license_set.py).

Each row is extracted from one line of a source document in the workspace (source + line + extract rule), never typed: run the script with --write-pin and PHRONESIS_WORKSPACE set to the workspace root.
sha256 is the digest of text; line_sha256 is the digest of the whole source line (UTF-8, LF), so a moved or edited source line fails the source test.
The tests prove each text equals its source line's extraction (when the workspace is on the machine), still hashes to its digest, and renders exactly where 'renders' says.

_doc: The API's flag-ON render of its RSL 1.0 document and its aipref Content-Usage value,
pinned so the site's static declaration is tested against the API's: site/license.xml
equals rsl_document byte for byte. The pin is the source file's content (its git blob
id), not a commit: the API pull request is squash-merged, so no branch commit reaches
main. read_from_commit names where the blob was read, for information only. Written by
a script from a render of a git-archive export of that commit and from the blob; never
typed. rendered_sha256 is the digest of the canonical JSON of 'rendered'.
